title: LLM accuracy iGPU tests fail downloading TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat from HuggingFace Hub (429 rate limit)

root_cause: The overall workflow failure is caused by the 'LLM accuracy iGPU tests' job hitting HuggingFace Hub's API rate limit (429 Too Many Requests, quota of 3000 api requests / 5 minutes) while resolving the TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 model tree; this is an external-service throttling event, not a code regression (the Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct cases in the same matrix passed, and TinyLlama ran fine later in the same 5-minute window in prior runs). Separately and independently, the non-blocking C++20 build job failed its CMake compiler ABI check because sccache's Azure Blob Storage cache backend rejected the `.sccache_check` probe request with an InvalidUri error, a recurring transient outage in the shared sccache Azure cache service that this job is explicitly configured not to gate on.
reproduction_steps: N/A - both failures are transient external-service outages (HuggingFace Hub API rate limiting and sccache's Azure Blob cache backend) not reproducible deterministically outside CI. To reproduce the HF rate limit locally, issue >3000 huggingface.co /api/models/* requests within a rolling 5-minute window using the same HF token used by this CI account.
recommended_actions: No code changes needed; rerun/retry the LLM accuracy iGPU tests job once the HuggingFace Hub per-token rate-limit window resets (requests reset every 5 minutes).

Consider caching or pre-resolving HF model file trees (e.g., via huggingface_hub offline/local cache or a mirrored model store) for TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 to avoid repeated `tree` API calls across concurrent CI jobs sharing the same HF token/quota.

Add automatic retry-with-backoff around huggingface_hub API calls in tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py (or the shared test fixture) to transparently recover from 429s using the `Retry-After` header already present in the response.
Track the sccache Azure Blob cache InvalidUri outage with the storage/cache-ops team (recurring signature, see historical context); no action required for this specific non-blocking build job.
prevention_strategies: Introduce a shared/rate-limit-aware HuggingFace Hub client wrapper (token bucket or exponential backoff honoring `Retry-After`) for all CI jobs that call the HF Hub API, and consider provisioning a dedicated higher-quota HF token or enterprise plan for CI to reduce the chance of hitting the 3000 req/5min ceiling during concurrent test matrix runs.
historical_context: The HuggingFace Hub 429 signature (hash 4dd69b5f0be10a15) was first observed 2026-10-12 on run 38260834403 affecting Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct downloads on dGPU tests; this run is the second occurrence and the first to affect TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 on iGPU tests, confirming it is a recurring external-service throttling pattern rather than a one-off. The sccache AzblobError InvalidUri signature was previously seen on 2026-11-06 (run 42166627607) in the same non-blocking C++20 build job, also co-occurring with an unrelated failure in that run (artifact FinalizeArtifact ECONNREFUSED) -- a similar prior Infrastructure sccache signature (hash c09f0ea325633f94, 'Timed out waiting for server startup') was also recorded on 2026-10-01, indicating sccache's Azure-backed cache service experiences periodic but distinct transient failure modes.
